---
name: Flip report
about: Share a real backflip (recording and/or video) so it can be compared with the simulator
title: "Flip report: <table> on <floor>"
labels: flip-report
---

**Table played:** (e.g. K7 405 L2)
**Robot:** weight, display on/off, servos, any changes
**Battery / supply:** voltage if known
**Floor:** (carpet, mat, grass, table...) and shoes or bare paws
**Result:** landed upright? front paws first? sat back / twisted?

Attach the telemetry CSV ("Record the next flip" on the firmware page) and, if you can, a 60 fps side-view video.
